_about: Numbers behind the rule-based electrical checks in review/electrical.py (design_review checks cap_voltage, tvs_clamp, ic_supply, joined_pins, mcu_pins, crystal_caps). Every entry carries its source. JSON has no comments: '_note' / 'source' keys are the comments. To extend, add an entry with a 'match' regex (searched, case-insensitive, in value + lib_id + MPN + LCSC part number) and cite where the numbers come from. Datasheet values: 'min'/'max' = recommended operating range, 'abs_max' = absolute maximum rating (null = not known; that check is skipped).

derating.source: Common design practice: MLCC rated >= 1.5x the applied DC voltage (DC-bias capacitance loss, ripple and transients; e.g. Murata/KEMET application notes recommend 50 % derating for class II), aluminium electrolytic and polymer/tantalum >= 1.25x (KEMET/Vishay tantalum guides recommend 20-50 %; 1.25x is the lenient end). headroom_warn: a supply at more than 95 % of an IC's maximum operating voltage leaves no margin for ripple, charging or load dump.

crystal.source: Pierce oscillator load: CL = C1*C2/(C1+C2) + Cstray; ST AN2867 'Oscillator design guide for STM8AF/AL/S and STM32 microcontrollers' uses Cstray ~ 2-5 pF (PCB + pin capacitance); 3-5 pF is the usual assumption for a short layout. A load inside [series+stray_min-tol, series+stray_max+tol] passes.

mlcc_voltage_codes._note: Rated voltage encoded in the MPN of the three MLCC families JLC stocks most. Patterns are anchored at the start of the MPN.

samsung.source: Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC part numbering (CL 10 A 106 K O 8NNNC: 6th field = rated voltage; checked against JLC C19666 CL10A475KO8NNNC 16V, C13585 CL31A106KBHNNNE 50V, C15850 CL21A106KAYNNNE 25V)

yageo.source: YAGEO CC series ordering code (CC 0603 K R X7R 9 BB 104: digit after the dielectric = rated voltage; checked against JLC C14663 CC0603KRX7R9BB104 50V)

murata.source: Murata GRM part numbering (GRM 18 8 R7 1H 104 KA01: 5th field = rated voltage)

tvs_families._note: Vrwm (stand-off) -> Vc max at Ipp for the 5 % 'A' / 'CA' grades. SMAJ, SMBJ, SMCJ and SMF share these breakdown/clamp numbers (they differ in power). Non-A (10 %) grades clamp higher and are not in the table: their clamp is taken from the part's LCSC attributes or reported as unknown.
tvs_families.source: Littelfuse SMBJ series datasheet, electrical characteristics table (VR / VC max @ IPP), same values in the SMAJ/SMCJ/SMF tables; cross-checked: JLC C19077573 SMBJ18A lists 18 V stand-off / 29.2 V clamp.

joined_pins.name: XKB TS-1187A tact switch
joined_pins.source: XKB TS-1187A-B-A-B datasheet (LCSC C318884) and its LCSC/EasyEDA symbol: A(1)-B(2) one contact, C(3)-D(4) the other

tactile_generic._not_lib_note: KiCad Switch.kicad_sym draws SW_Push_Dual / SW_Push_Open_Dual as a ganged DPST button: 1-2 and 3-4 are the SWITCHED pairs (open contact circles under a movable bar), never joined, whatever footprint it carries.
tactile_generic._note: An unlisted 4-pin tactile switch is ASSUMED to join 1-2 and 3-4 (the usual 6x6 / 5.1x5.1 mm numbering); findings on it are warnings that say so, never errors.

boot0_shared.source: ST RM0440 (STM32G4 reference manual) section 'Boot configuration' and DS12589 pinout: PB8 is shared with BOOT0, sampled at reset when option bit nSWBOOT0=1 (factory default)
